93963.description:
We have taken the costs of all units in the game (that includes movable units as well as buildings) and mixed them up thoroughly.

Every day at 12:00 UTC, this mod is updated with a new permutation.

A few things to note:

- This includes costs from units that are not available in regular gameplay

- Units from Unit Lines (like Militia, Man-at-Arms, Long Swordsman) no longer cost the same amount

- Male and Female villager may have different costs, and depending on which one gets randomly chosen, you may not be able to queue one if you lack the resources

- There are sometimes different units for buildings in different ages, which means those buildings change cost when you age up. This is most noticeable with Houses.

93968.description:
This is a literal port of danielpereira's and Gallas' Kidnap mod on Voobly.

Your Scout Cavalry / Eagle Scout no longer has attack, but has the ability to kidnap enemy villagers.

Right click an enemy villager to kidnap it.

When the Scout "attacks" the villager, it disappears, and your Scout will gain one garrisoned unit. One Scout can only carry one villager at a time.

After picking up a villager, the Scout will move back to your Town Center. You can also manually right click on your Town Center to send it back.

Once the Scout reaches your town center, it will unload the villager and the villager will be under your control.

Attention: Unloading currently seems to be very buggy with Scouts that have the Autoscout ability! Those can sometimes only pick up a villager once and that's it.

If you upgradeyour Scout to Light Cavalry / Eagle Warrior, they lose the kidnap ability.

 

This mod is generated by auto-mods, a SiegeEngineers project.
